badge.$description: Badge component tokens: non-interactive labels on listings. Measured from the audit's captured CSS: the homepage photo label ('Office', 'Coworking'; class 'pill', audit F13, 48 instances) and the dark blue 'Virtual Tour' label (class 'tag tag-virtual-tour', 64 instances, filed by the audit under F14 chip but not interactive). Decision 25.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: pill (57px on a 29px label). Pills are for things that float over content (decision 25 reverses decision 23's 4px).

background.$description: OBSERVED: white at 50% over photos; became the 85% overlay. At 50%, ink drops to 4.31:1 over a dark photo (below 4.5); at 85% it stays 12.07:1 or more.
PROPOSED: grey label on white surfaces (not over photos).
OBSERVED: navy auction banner colour (146 el).

feature.$description: The edge-attached label ('Virtual Tour'): square, uppercase, sits flush in a photo corner.

background.$description: OBSERVED: dark blue #123a7a 'Virtual Tour' label (64 el).

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 10px; became 12px, the system's smallest size (decision 25).

radius.$description: OBSERVED: square: it's attached to the photo's edge (decision 25).

letter-spacing.$description: PROPOSED: a little tracking keeps small uppercase text legible (observed: none).
